meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按这份指南排查容器化 agent 的问题：查宿主日志、会话数据库（inbound.db/outbound.db）、挂载点和心跳文件，并给出重复服务实例、认证失败、MCP 配置错误等常见问题的定位与修复步骤。
howto.when: 当容器跑不起来、机器人不回消息、认证报错（如 401），或你想弄清容器系统的消息流与挂载时使用。

say.text: 打开 LOG_LEVEL=debug，帮我查容器为什么退出
say.note: 会输出完整挂载配置和容器 stderr。

say.text: 查这个会话的 inbound.db 和 outbound.db，看有没有回复
say.note: 判断消息是否到容器、agent 是否产出回复。

say.text: 跑一遍快速诊断脚本，检查 Docker、agent 镜像和 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 逐项报出 Docker、镜像、网关等状态。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows this guide to debug containerized agent issues: it inspects host logs, session DBs (inbound.db/outbound.db), mounts and heartbeat, and covers fixes for duplicate services, auth failures and MCP errors.
howto.when_en: Use when the container fails, the bot stops replying, auth errors appear (e.g. 401), or you want to understand the container message flow and mounts.

say_en.text: Turn on LOG_LEVEL=debug and check the container stderr to see why it exited.
say_en.note: Raises log level and shows container stderr.

say_en.text: Check this session's inbound.db and outbound.db for arrived messages and replies.
say_en.note: Tells whether messages reached the container.

say_en.text: Run the quick diagnostic script to check Docker, agent image and OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Reports Docker, image and gateway status.
